description: This is a Java interface for the Likelihood repository, extending Spring Data JPA repositories for CRUD and query execution related to Likelihood entities. It includes a custom query method to find Likelihood objects by ppiName excluding a specific id.

classes.name: LikelihoodRepository
classes.description: Spring Data JPA repository interface for managing Likelihood entities with custom query methods.

methods.name: findByPpiNameAndLikeliHoodId
methods.description: Finds list of Likelihood entities matching a given ppiName, excluding the entity with the specified id.
